create_agent_for_env: create an Agent for a gym environment with an optional policy or random fallback
create_agent_with_serving_policy: create an Agent for a gym environment using a prebuilt serving policy
act_on_observation: act on a single observation and return the extracted action with log probability
post_step_callback: call the post transition callback after an environment step with a Transition object
post_episode_callback: call the post episode callback after an episode ends with a Trajectory and info dict
